_meta.description: Accumulative supplementary icon set. Grows as builds encounter icon-gap warnings. Keys/titles join the brand token index alongside svgl; svgl wins on key collision.
_meta.sources: Simple Icons (CC0 shapes, trademark caveat) via https://cdn.simpleicons.org/; Iconify API (https://api.iconify.design/) as fallback — per-set licenses recorded per entry.
_meta.policy: Missing icon → run scripts/add-icon.mjs <term>, commit, rebuild. Source + license + date recorded per entry.
